spec._comment: DECLARATIVE carrier floorplan - edit this to drive the PCB placement. Order in each edge list = order ALONG that edge (N/S left->right, W/E top->bottom). interior: {"side":N/E/S/W} or {"near":<subsystem>}. Any subsystem omitted falls back to auto-derivation. Regenerate this seed with `schgen floorplan --export`.

pull.basis: D11 near_max edge-gap <=20mm proxy for Pulse v7 p.1 <=25mm part-to-part (T1 P7a ethernet wave): magnetics seat at the RJ45 jack. Migrated per D-1 seat-consistency rule when ethernet joins _WIRED_SHEETS - same mechanism as usb_pd's pd_input pull.
D11 edge-seat override (audit 2026-07-28): CP2102N FS pair terminates at the UART USB-C - near_max judgment:40.0 edge-gap; bare-near attraction overlapped board_aux (DRC 41, measured)

single_ended.signals: None present. The RTL8211F PHY is on the SoM, so RGMII (TXD/RXD/TX_CTL/RX_CTL/clocks) is internal to the SoM. The carrier carries only the transformer-isolated MDI pairs (ETH_PHY_MDI*/ETH_LINE_MDI*). If RGMII were carrier-routed it would be 50Ω SE.
single_ended.spec_cite: RTL8211F / TI SNLA387 / DP83867 RGMII layout: 50Ω SE, route TX (TXD+TXC) and RX (RXD+RXC) groups together length-balanced ±a few mm, max ~10 cm (≈3900 mil); add 22Ω series near driver if >3 cm. Cited only as the applicable spec IF RGMII is added — no carrier net exists.

single_ended.signals: ZYNQ_HDMI_TX_SCL/SDA, HDMI_RX_SCL/SDA (I2C DDC 100 kHz), *_CEC, *_HPD — low-speed single-ended, no controlled-impedance requirement
single_ended.spec_cite: HDMI 1.4b Sec 4.2 (DDC=I2C, CEC, HPD are low-speed; no Zo/length constraint). Listed for completeness — these are not SI-critical nets.

pull.basis: D11 near_max edge-gap <=20mm proxy for Pulse v7 p.1 <=25mm part-to-part (T1 P7a ethernet wave): magnetics seat at the RJ45 jack. Migrated per D-1 seat-consistency rule when ethernet joins _WIRED_SHEETS - same mechanism as usb_pd's pd_input pull.
D11 edge-seat override (audit 2026-07-28): CP2102N FS pair terminates at the UART USB-C - near_max judgment:40.0 edge-gap; bare-near attraction overlapped board_aux (DRC 41, measured)
D11 edge-seat override, migrated from _EDGE_SEAT_BLOCKS (T1 P3): FUSB302 PD PHY seats at its Type-C inlet - CC-run near_max (judgment:10.0 edge-gap) + usb_pd->power flow budget

expected.outline_note: SoM 50x42 + 7mm halo + 11mm connector band/edge -> core 86x78; component area 6062mm2 / 0.6 fill -> area floor 123x111; + 3mm perimeter keepout -> 130x120 mm (rounded up to 5mm grid); then SMALLEST-AREA search over aspects 1, 1.0833, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4 -> 168x163 mm (the smallest board holding the REAL 2-sided packed blocks with the estimated cross-subsystem airwire 16194 <= LAW-5 budget 16383 mm — honest routing headroom, the gate is not relaxed), SoM 50x42 centered

notes.short: SDIO 1.8V island: TXS02612 splits 1.8V / 3.3V sides
notes.long: microSD: SDIO runs at 1.8 V on the SoM side (typed sd_bus level in the netlist) — keep the TXS02612 translator mid-block: 1.8V side faces the SoM, 3.3V card side faces the slot; bus length match <= 2.5 mm to CLK.

notes.short: power inlet: VBUS->TVS->bulk->+VIN; CC pair to FUSB302
notes.long: PD power inlet: keep the VBUS path (receptacle -> TVS -> bulk -> +VIN) in one corner so the +VIN plane spreads from a single point; CC1/CC2 route to the FUSB302 (usb_pd block, anchored next to this inlet). PLAN.md round 5: a TPS25940-class eFuse lands between receptacle and bulk — reserve space for it here.

notes.short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
notes.long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.

notes.short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
notes.long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.

notes.short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
notes.long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.

notes.short: LCD FFC exit; backlight boost loop tight
notes.long: 40-pin LCD FFC: cable exits over the board edge; keep the SY7201ABC backlight boost loop (L/D/C) tight and away from the FFC signal rows; RGB888 bus is single-ended bank-34 3V3 — bus-route together.

notes.short: camera FFC: 3 CSI-2 pairs 100R to J3 side
notes.long: RPi camera FFC: 3 MIPI CSI-2 pairs at 100R differential to the J3 side of the SoM (bank 35, 2.5 V VCCO per the expect= notes) — keep the run to the J3 strip short.

notes.short: 4 TMDS pairs 100R; companion IC at connector
notes.long: 4 TMDS pairs at 100R differential, intra-pair skew <= 0.15 mm (constraints.py); place TPD12S016PWR directly behind the receptacle so all pairs pass straight through.

notes.short: 4 TMDS pairs 100R; companion IC at connector
notes.long: 4 TMDS pairs at 100R differential, intra-pair skew <= 0.15 mm (constraints.py); place M24C02-WMN6TP directly behind the receptacle so all pairs pass straight through.

notes.short: PMOD pair on gated +3V3_PMOD rail
notes.long: Two PMOD sockets side by side; both fed from the gated +3V3_PMOD rail (SY6280 cell in bringup_modules) — route the gated rail once, star at the sockets.

notes.short: PMOD pair on gated +3V3_PMOD rail
notes.long: Two PMOD sockets side by side; both fed from the gated +3V3_PMOD rail (SY6280 cell in bringup_modules) — route the gated rail once, star at the sockets.

notes.short: 10 load switches: gated-rail star points
notes.long: 10 SY6280 load-switch cells; each gated rail (+3V3_CAM, +3V3_HDMI_RX, +3V3_HDMI_TX, +3V3_LCD, +3V3_PMOD, +3V3_SD, +3V3_USER_LED, +5V_HDMI_TX, +5V_LCD, +5V_USB) stars from its switch — place this block centrally so every gated rail leaves toward its module without crossing the others.

notes.short: rail-EN DIPs + PG LEDs: human access
notes.long: Rail-enable DIP switches + power-good LEDs: face them where fingers and eyes reach them with the mezzanine mounted — keep clear of the SoM shadow.

notes.short: JTAG/SWD headers vertical: probe clearance
notes.long: JTAG (2x7 2 mm) + SWD (2x5 1.27 mm) headers mate vertically — any top-side spot works; keep cable/probe clearance and the boot DIP reachable.

notes.short: magnetics keep-out: no planes line-side; 100R MDI
notes.long: Magnetics isolation: void ALL planes under the HX5008 line side + Bob-Smith network (CHASSIS_GND moat to the RJ45); MDI pairs are 100R differential. RJ45 itself is an author-declared deferral (expect rj45_connector) — the dashed reservation is its landing zone.

notes.short: bank-35 IO header: VADJ LDO copper
notes.long: TLV75725PDYDR VADJ LDO dissipates ~0.32 W at the declared 0.4 A — give its EP pad a ground pour.

notes.short: 2 bucks: thermal copper + vias; keep SW loops tight
notes.long: Buck thermal (worst-case declared draws): LM61460AANRJRR +5V_REG ~1.52 W; LM61460AANRJRR +3V3_REG ~0.82 W. Pour copper on the SW/PGND side, stitch vias under the packages, keep each SW node loop minimal.

notes.short: INA3221 shunts sit IN the rail path
notes.long: Power monitor: the shunt resistors are in series with the rails — the rails must physically route through this block; place it between the regulators and the loads, Kelvin-connect the sense pairs.

notes.short: USB-UART conn deferred; TPs on TX/RX
notes.long: CP2102N UART bridge: its USB connector is an author-declared deferral (expect usb_uart_connector) — the block reserves edge space for it; TX/RX test points stay probe-able.

notes.short: FUSB302 beside inlet: short CC stubs
notes.long: FUSB302 PD controller: anchored beside the pd_input receptacle so CC1/CC2 stay short stubs; I2C runs to the SoM J1 side.

notes.short: LEDs + buttons human-facing
notes.long: User LEDs + buttons: human-facing — keep at the accessible S side, clear of the PMOD cable shadow.

notes.short: 58 test points board-wide
notes.long: 58 test points board-wide (test-point gate): spread them with probe clearance as the blocks settle; none may end up under the SoM.
